How search matches your text > Fuzzy operators (~= and ~*)

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Rule:__TRILIUM_PH_1__ the fuzzy operators tolerate typos. __TRILIUM_PH_2__ (fuzzy-equals) matches a value that is a close whole-word variant of your term. __TRILIUM_PH_3__ (fuzzy-contains) matches when your term appears anywhere inside the value, either as a fragment or as a near-miss. Both work on note properties such as __TRILIUM_PH_4__ and __TRILIUM_PH_5__, and on labels (__TRILIUM_PH_6__). Fuzzy operators accept terms of at least 3 characters, though how many typos each term tolerates depends on its length — see __TRILIUM_PH_7__Fuzzy tolerance__TRILIUM_PH_8__ below.
